=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:16779-16891 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: harness_heal_auto_revalidate() posts its one-shot /revalidate as soon as the heal issue is closed with ai:merged. It never checks that the consumer's validation pin (validation_harness_pin(), lines 16065-16075) contains the fix. validation_harness_hold_tick() (lines 16611-16674) does check this, through pin_unchanged, ahead, and heal_closed_after_pin.
  WHY: If the heal merges before @stable is released or before the consumer's ai-validate.yml pin is bumped, validation reruns on the old harness and fails again. The once-only marker (already_posted / route_already-fixed) then blocks any further automatic retry, so the project stays parked with ai:harness-broken until someone posts /revalidate by hand. All three reviewers rated it MAJOR. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash checked this claim and rejected it, citing plan P7 item 1 (docs/plans/remove-unattended-pipeline-stuck-states-plan.md:324-330).
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:2342-2347 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new FP_JOB_ID jq filter `(... | capture("/check-runs/(?<id>[1-9][0-9]*)$") | .id) // .id` errors when check_run_url is missing or does not match. The `//` operator does not catch that error, so the `.id` fallback never runs and FP_JOB_ID ends up empty.
  WHY: The annotations fetch is skipped and no AI_FAILURE_FINGERPRINT_V1 marker is emitted (or the fingerprint falls back to no-error-line). That breaks the once-per-fingerprint guard and the P3b breaker, and also the _pff_jobs() smoke test (tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:10001-10016, 10315-10317). Severity disagreement: gemini rated it BLOCKER, the others MAJOR; the highest is used. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 checked this claim and rejected it, saying capture() with no match emits nothing rather than raising an error. It also noted the file is not in this PR's changed-file list.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:3581 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: This is the same FP_JOB_ID jq capture/fallback defect: when check_run_url is missing or does not match, the error aborts the filter before `// .id` runs.
  WHY: FP_JOB_ID is left empty, the check-run annotations fetch is skipped, and fingerprint markers are missing or wrong. Severity disagreement: gemini rated it BLOCKER, the others MAJOR; the highest is used. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disputes the claim (see above).
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:3497-3503 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The FP_JOB_ID extraction at line 3500 depends on `//` to fall back to `.id`, but capture raises an error on no match, so the fallback never runs.
  WHY: Jobs without a matching check_run_url (for example the `_pff_jobs` fixture) skip the annotations GET, get a `no-error-line` fingerprint, and emit no marker. The P3b breaker can then trip on unrelated jobs. This is likely the same defect as plan.yml:3581, but the line ranges do not overlap, so the entries were not merged.
- scripts/ai_labels.py:1140-1150 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new 180-second RETIRED_LABEL_DRAIN_DEADLINE_SECONDS deadline (lines 37-41, initialised at 1316-1319) is checked only before each item. It does not bound an API call already in flight: _github_api_request (lines 266-280) makes 3 attempts with a 120-second timeout each, which is 360 seconds or more.
  WHY: One slow call can run past the 5-minute job timeout (.github/workflows/sync_ai_labels.yml:43). The job is then killed before LABEL_SYNC_RETIRED_DRAIN_DEFERRED reason=budget, errors[] or deferred_reason are recorded, and the label can be left half-drained. All four reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:16763-16772,16806-16817 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: A failed POST response makes the function return without recording a marker, and the code does not handle a lost POST response where the comment does exist on GitHub.
  WHY: The project stays parked as failed even though the heal issue merged, because the next tick finds the existing comment and skips. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash checked this and rejected it: the REVALIDATE_COMMENT_JSON selector (lines 28055-28072) picks up the posted comment as a pending /revalidate on the next tick.
- scripts/ai_labels.py:1140-1141,1229-1246 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The new wall-clock deferral (RETIRED_LABEL_DRAIN_DEADLINE_SECONDS, lines 37-41, and the deadline break) has no test coverage. The test harness has no hook to advance time.monotonic().
  WHY: Regressions in the deadline check, such as an off-by-one, `>=` vs `>`, or a missing reset, would not be caught by CI, so the deferral path could break silently.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:16738-16744 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The temporary file created for the heal revalidate post is not removed on every error path.
  WHY: Temp files can build up on the runner disk when posting fails.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The linked issue's files_touched grant states "Implementation is limited to these paths". Issue #8829 is scoped to P7b (harness heal auto-revalidate). P2a, P3a, P4, P11a and P11b ship in their own PRs (docs/plans/remove-unattended-pipeline-stuck-states-plan.md:392-395).
  expected_change_site: Only the granted P7b paths: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml, tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py, tests/test_orchestrate_poll_workflow_contract.py, README.md, agents.d/stuck-states-p7b-harness-auto-revalidate.md, changelog.d/stuck-states-p7b-harness-auto-revalidate.md, plus the globs tests/**, changelog.d/* and agents.d/*.
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The last-run diff edits .github/workflows/clarify.yml and .github/workflows/plan.yml (P3a truthy parse and FP_JOB_ID/check_run_url change), scripts/ai_labels.py (P11a RETIRED_LABEL_DRAIN_DEADLINE_SECONDS deadline), agents.d/stuck-states-p11a-retired-label-drain.md, agents.d/stuck-states-p3a-fingerprint-markers.md and changelog.d/stuck-states-p3a-fingerprint-markers.md. It also adds README.md rows for SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_UNIFIED_ENABLED, RETIRED_LABEL_DRAIN_ENABLED, ZOMBIE_RUN_REAPER_ENABLED and ZOMBIE_RUN_MAX_QUEUED_HOURS (P2a/P11a/P11b). None of this is in the P7b grant, and the last run adds no P7b code. All four reviewers rated it MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 dropped this gap: it says these files are not in pr_changed_files.txt or the gh pr diff for this PR.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:harness_heal_auto_revalidate(), heal-issue gate at about lines 16779-16792, then the POST of the "<!-- AI_HARNESS_HEAL_REVALIDATE_V1 heal=<n> -->" comment | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The function posts its one-shot /revalidate as soon as the heal issue is closed with ai:merged. It never checks that the fix has reached the consumer's pinned harness (validation_harness_pin(), lines 16065-16075). The hold path checks pin_unchanged (line 16631), ahead (line 16640) and heal_closed_after_pin (line 16672).
  WHY: If the heal merges before @stable or before the pin bump, validation reruns the old harness and fails again. The marker then gives already_posted or route_already-fixed, the project returns to failed with ai:harness-broken, and the one retry is spent. The self_repo case is not affected.
- NOTE: Rejected the pass-1 claim that a lost POST response parks the project for good. The REVALIDATE_COMMENT_JSON selector (lines 28055-28072) picks up the comment on the next tick.
- NOTE: Rejected the pass-1 claim about the jq capture fallback in .github/workflows/plan.yml:3581 and .github/workflows/clarify.yml:2347. capture() with no match emits nothing, so the filter falls back to .id. These files are also not in the PR's changed-file list.
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. The P7b deliverables are present. The pass-1 scope-creep gap was dropped because the out-of-grant files are not in pr_changed_files.txt or the gh pr diff.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, harness_heal_auto_revalidate(), after the VHH_ISSUE_MERGED check and before the POST. Call validation_harness_pin and compare VHH_PIN_DATE. If the pin cannot be resolved, or VHH_ISSUE_CLOSED_AT is later than the pin date, log outcome=waiting reason=heal_closed_after_pin (or pin_unresolved) and return 0. Skip the check in the harness repo itself. Estimated 8-10 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

  WHY: The jq capture error ends the job before the fallback runs, so fingerprint markers are not generated for many failed jobs.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:16763-16772 and 16806-16817 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4

  WHY: The project stays parked as failed even though the heal issue merged, because the next tick finds the existing comment and skips.

README.md also includes unrelated P2a/P11a/P11b variables.
